notes.title: Update: General Improvements and Optimizations
notes.content:
We've just released a new update for SnaPaul, focusing on improving the overall player experience! Here's what's new:

Improved performance in certain areas of the game.
Fixed minor bugs reported by the community.
Optimized lighting and textures for smoother gameplay.
General quality-of-life improvements.
Thank you for your support and feedback! We're committed to making SnaPaul even better. 

Let us know what you think about this update, and stay tuned for more!
